title: Pediatric and Ambulatory Research in Infectious Diseases
official: Real Time Surveillance of Pediatric Infectious Diseases in French Ambulatory Care: PARI Study
summary: Many ambulatory networks are mainly based on diagnoses made by first-line physicians not specifically trained to join the network. Here we aim to set up a surveillance network on pediatric infectious diseases with an investment in teaching with specific trainings of participating pediatricians, increasing in use of point of care tests, and automated data extraction from the computers of the pediatricians.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children under 16 years of age with at least one infectious disease among:
* pharyngitis
* otitis
* pneumonia
* influenza
* bronchiolitisz
* varicella
* gastroenteritis
* enterovirus disease
* bordetella pertussis disease
* using the same same software, Axi5-Infansoft (developed by CompuGroup Medical, Nanterre, France)

Exclusion Criteria:

* parental refusal
sponsor: Association Clinique Thérapeutique Infantile du val de Marne
